name: Gander Gold Corporation
summary: Gander Gold Corporation specializes in sourcing, examining, and advancing mineral sites throughout Canada. The firm currently manages eight distinct gold-centric undertakings in Newfoundland, which together encompass 9,032 claims across a vast area of 2,257 square kilometers. Furthermore, it possesses an option agreement paving the way to a full 100% ownership stake in several significant Newfoundland projects. These include Gander North, Gander South, Little River, Hermitage, Carmanville, Cape Ray, Mount Peyton, and the combined Botwood, Laurenceton, Thwart Island (BLT) project. Established in 2021, Gander Gold Corporation's corporate base is situated in Vancouver, Canada, and it operates as a controlled entity under Sassy Gold Corp.
